LESSON: ORAL PRESENTATIONS: DELIVERING SPEECHES

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 10.1.1: Oral Presentations: Delivering Speeches

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Oral Presentations: Delivering Speeches. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What makes one a good storyteller?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. use oral narrative techniques during the performance
2. appreciate the importance of performance techniques in the successful delivery of oral material

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: ORAL PRESENTATIONS: DELIVERING SPEECHES
Subject: ENGLISH · Grade: Grade 7
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Oral Presentations: Delivering Speeches helps you succeed in ENGLISH. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

KEY FACTS: ORAL PRESENTATIONS: DELIVERING SPEECHES
Language skills grow by daily practice: listen carefully, speak clearly, read every day, write neatly.
Model → guided practice → independent practice.
Always use complete sentences when writing answers.

PART 1: Use oral narrative techniques during the performance

What this means
In this part you learn to use oral narrative techniques during the performance. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: use oral narrative techniques during the performance.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model reading: Read a short paragraph about “Oral Presentations: Delivering Speeches”, then retell it in 3 sentences.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can use oral narrative techniques during the performance. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Appreciate the importance of performance techniques in the successful delivery of oral material

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate the importance of performance techniques in the successful delivery of oral material. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate the importance of performance techniques in the successful delivery of oral material.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model speaking: Say 4 clear sentences about Oral Presentations: Delivering Speeches to a partner.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate the importance of performance techniques in the successful delivery of oral material. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Oral Presentations: Delivering Speeches is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Read a short paragraph about “Oral Presentations: Delivering Speeches”, then retell it in 3 sentences. (skill: use oral narrative techniques during the performance)

Example 2: Say 4 clear sentences about Oral Presentations: Delivering Speeches to a partner. (skill: appreciate the importance of performance techniques in the successful delivery of oral material)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Oral Presentations: Delivering Speeches to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: use oral narrative techniques during the performance.
3. Practise this skill: appreciate the importance of performance techniques in the successful delivery of oral material.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Oral Presentations: Delivering Speeches from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Oral Presentations: Delivering Speeches: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 7 learner study Oral Presentations: Delivering Speeches?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What makes one a good storyteller?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Oral Presentations: Delivering Speeches means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: use oral narrative techniques during the performance.
5. Be able to: appreciate the importance of performance techniques in the successful delivery of oral material.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
